QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Liberating Some Armor
QuestInfo.0: Ask #bHarpoon#k, at the #bReclamation HQ#k, about which supplies to gather next.
QuestInfo.1: Harpoon said the next supplies they need are armor, and asked you to defeat the #rSpecter Shieldbearers#k in #bForest of Choices#k and get #b10 #t4000730##k items.

1.0: One shield...two shields...perfect! Our soldiers will have the best gear on the battlefield! Thank you very much!
1.1: This should be enough supplies. Hehe... #rSteal it if you can't get it otherwise#k! I learned an important life lesson here.

yes.0: It seems #bEdea#k has something to say. Why don't you go see her now that everything is done?

item.0: Defeat the #rSpecter Shieldbearers#k in the #bForest of Choices#k and get around #b10 #t4000730##k items. Haha, good luck!
